query: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read reports for admins only" ON support_reports; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read bugs for admins only" ON support_bugs; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow all for file transfers" ON koda_file_transfers; CREATE POLICY "Allow file transfer inserts" ON koda_file_transfers FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true); CREATE POLICY "Allow file transfer selects" ON koda_file_transfers FOR SELECT USING (true);
